Question 1

The figure above shows the graph of a function y=f(x). Which of the following could be the second-degree Taylor polynomial for f about x=2?

a
 1−x2
b
 1−(x−2)2
c
 1+(x−2)−(x−2)2
d
 1+(x−2)2
e
 2+(x−2)−(x−2)2
